name: files.write_text
precondition: path is a non-empty string; text is a str; the parent directory exists; append is a bool.
postcondition: Creates or overwrites (or appends to) the file at path with the given text encoded as UTF-8. Parent directories are NOT created. Side-effect: writes to the filesystem.
failure_mode: PreconditionError when path is empty, parent directory does not exist, or path is not a string; OSError propagated on disk-space failure or read-only filesystem.
returns: str: the absolute path of the written file.
